Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Live gates P0-P3 and U are closed; P4-P8 remain open. Current source includes spatial route and codec improvements, but FreeSurfer/native writers, current inverse/overlap adoption and final review still have explicit gaps. New provider remote tips are not automatically admitted pins.

Fresh context: Yes: partial epic / external qualification.

Next action: Continue the nonclosed leaf packets and refresh exact provider/oracle parity-ledger evidence, then final integration review; do not restart closed phases.

Evidence: live blocking graph; docs/verification/stp-finish-20260929/README.md; build.sbt; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Implement typed spatial transforms for ScalaFIM per docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md: read, understand, convert, compose and apply ITK/ANTs, FSL, AFNI, FreeSurfer and X5 transforms, with feature parity to ~/code/neurotransform and ~/code/neurofunctor, in idiomatic Scala 3 (frames as types, direction as a type, conventions only at the edge) and native-tool oracle evidence.

Structure: phase gates P0-P8 plus an upstream gate U (reframe4s). Child containment is non-blocking; native blocks edges form the execution DAG; each gate is blocked by its packets and the epic by the terminal gates. Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. Filter: mote ls --tag spatial-transforms; stp-p0..stp-p8, stp-u, stp-task, stp-gate, stp-upstream, stp-qualification.

Hard boundaries: authority ledger (image4s geometry, reframe4s transforms/resampling, Gale linear algebra; ScalaFIM policy and adapters only); imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck names; JVM+JS for every packet; bounded sbt batches; explicit pathspec staging; no push or release.

Definition of done: all gates accepted; every parity-ledger row in the plan verified by oracle-backed tests; final independent integration review (P8.05) accepted. Filing this epic implements nothing.

Reused live issues: bd-01M37FQFRRF1TW2REJPWS8BRM8 (NLin6<->2009c inter-template warp, prerequisite of P7.07); bd-01M37FQGV8ZPT30X37TA4MM8R7 (GIFTI frame metadata gaps, related to P1.04).
